paragraphs: Our first-rate team offers comfortable and modern family dental care for the Leland community.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.
Comprehensive dental care for every member of your family. From routine cleanings to advanced treatments, we provide exceptional care with the latest technology and techniques.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Welcome to our Leland office! Right off West Gate Dr, reachable via Highway 17, our Leland location provides care for patients traveling from the nearby neighborhoods such as Belville, Navassa, Wilmington, and more. With our highly advanced technology and an experienced team, we provide the comfort and confidence you need for a healthy, pain-free smile!

Our modern, inviting space is filled with a professional, experienced team that strongly believes that dental care and treatment start with patient comfort. Therefore, we strive for our office and amenities to be designed with our patients’ health and well-being in mind. Situated in a suburban community that blends small-town charm with convenient access to the Walmart Shopping Center, this location is accessible and easy to travel to. Our Leland office stands out with its peaceful atmosphere, where patients feel supported and leave motivated to take care of their oral health with ease and comfort.
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Leland office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.
We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!
To schedule a visit, feel free to call us or book an appointment online to get you in as soon as possible! We look forward to treating you and providing you with the comfort and care you deserve!
Yes! By using the cutting-edge CAD/CAM technology, we are able to offer same-day crowns that provide permanent, custom-fit, and natural-looking metal-free restoration.

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants. You can schedule an appointment or request a consultation to make sure you’re getting the best treatment suited available.

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our Leland location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!
Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.
Our office Hours are Monday-Thursday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Friday: 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday.

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
Our office in Leland is located at 1215 West Gate Drive, Suite 180, Leland, NC 28451. We provide free parking, and the parking lot includes wheelchair-accessible spaces to accommodate all visitors.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What types of dental services are offered for families and children in Leland?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

How do I schedule a dental appointment at the Leland office?

To schedule a visit, feel free to call us or book an appointment online to get you in as soon as possible! We look forward to treating you and providing you with the comfort and care you deserve!

Do you offer same-day crowns or restorations in Leland?

Yes! By using the cutting-edge CAD/CAM technology, we are able to offer same-day crowns that provide permanent, custom-fit, and natural-looking metal-free restoration.

Can I get dental implants or a consultation at your Leland location?

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants. You can schedule an appointment or request a consultation to make sure you’re getting the best treatment suited available. 

Are emergency dental appointments available in Leland?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our Leland location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Does the Leland office offer cosmetic treatments like whitening or veneers?

Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

What hours is the Leland office open, and is Saturday available?

Our office Hours are Monday-Thursday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Friday: 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Do you accept dental insurance or offer payment plans in Leland?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

Where is the Leland office located, and what parking/accessibility is available?

Our office in Leland is located at 1215 West Gate Drive, Suite 180, Leland, NC 28451. We provide free parking, and the parking lot includes wheelchair-accessible spaces to accommodate all visitors.
